notes.title: Post-Launch Development Roadmap
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Players![/h2]

We’re excited to share some specific information about our upcoming plans and actions. We’ve prepared a roadmap that outlines our goals until the end of the year, giving you a clearer view of what to expect in the near future. The roadmap highlights seasonal changes and major improvements that we have planned for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508882/e1b962fbf26f35243c7d9223e6e09ddb3289da4e.png[/img]

[b]October: Inventory System and Watch Fixes, Item Interactions, Achievements, and Bhaptics Integration[/b]

October brings major improvements to item interactions and the interactive watch. Moving objects and how they behave in the environment will feel more intuitive and realistic. We’re also excited to introduce a new achievement system, adding an extra layer of challenge and satisfaction to your gameplay. Alongside these updates, crowbar and key mechanics will be refined, making them more responsive. For an even more immersive experience, we’re integrating Bhaptics vest support, allowing you to physically feel in-game interactions through haptic feedback.

[b]November: Halloween Spooky Update & Hand Customization[/b]

Get ready for a hauntingly atmospheric Halloween Spooky Update! Explore Chernobyl with spooky vibe perfect for the season. In addition, we’ll introduce personalized handsets, letting you customize how your virtual hands look and feel in-game, making your VR experience even more personalized.

[b]December: Christmas Vibe Update[/b]

As the year winds down, December will bring a festive atmosphere with the Christmas Vibe Update. Enjoy the spirit of the holidays with seasonal spirit, enhancing the post-apocalyptic landscape of Chernobyl with a unique holiday twist.

[b]In addition,[/b] we are actively addressing bugs across all platforms to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience for everyone. We’re working hard to fix the issues that have been reported, and we’ll continue to provide updates as we make progress.

[b]Stay tuned for more details and thank you for your ongoing support![/b]
Chernobyl Again Dev Team

notes.title: The Patch 1.0 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players![/h1]
The premiere of our game took place a week ago, and today we have some important information to share with you. We’d like to provide details regarding the patch aimed at addressing various issues. Over the past week, we have focused on resolving both major and minor bugs across all platforms, which were not only affecting the overall gameplay experience but also preventing progress in some parts of the game. We understand how frustrating these problems have been and appreciate your patience as we work to improve the stability and performance.

[h2]Below we will note what we have changed on [b]Steam VR[/b]:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hand shrinking fixed.
[*] Suitcase no longer disappears.
[*] Placing the gun for syringe in the inventory along with the syringe works correctly.
[*] Sparks sound fixed.
[*] Mask collisions fixed.
[*] Desk cannot be pulled out anymore.
[*] Improved task detection for item collection.
[*] Fixed issue with the "take the key from the inventory" dialogue – gameplay no longer gets stuck after triggering the dialogue a second time due to lack of interaction.
[*] Cable mechanics improved to provide hints suggesting the correct way to solve the puzzle.
[*] After loading the game following the completion of the cable mechanic, the player no longer ends up outside the map.
[*] Voice variation and longer delay between reminders during the cable mechanic.
[*] Restored antenna sound to assist with its correct placement on the level, preventing gameplay blockage.
[*] Save system improved.
[*] Improved interaction with valves.
[*] Longer delay and additional checks to disable reminders when searching for the car to push or for the first note.
[*] Added new effects for bHaptics devices.
[*] Pause menu glitch fixed.
[*] Disabled grab and highlight of objects during level transitions.
[*] Improved behavior of the ball in maze mechanics.
[*] Fixed elevator behavior after load game.
[*] Added highlight to signal finder on/off knob.
[*] Fixed error causing remove all tasks when load game with more than 10 tasks in list.
[*] Fixed the issue with displaying controller graphics in the pause menu.
[*] Added crouching in standing mode.
[*] Removed the ability to pick up objects between level transitions.
[*] Improved the mechanics of the puzzle box with the maze.
[*] Removed blockers that required exiting to the menu and selecting "continue" to reset the game state.
[*] Head collision with the valve no longer causes the screen to fade.
[*] Other smaller fixes.
[/list]
As you can see, we’ve implemented a number of crucial changes that should significantly improve your gameplay experience. However, we know there is still more work to be done. Currently we are working to improve the interactions with the watch and inventory system.

We are currently working on a post-release roadmap to give you a clearer picture of our plans for the upcoming months. We’ll continue to keep you informed about future patches and fixes. 

Our primary goal is to ensure that you can fully enjoy the game, and we are dedicated to addressing all existing issues as quickly and thoroughly as possible. In the meantime, we would greatly appreciate your feedback and insights. If you encounter any further problems or have suggestions, please feel free to share them with us on our Discord server. Your input is invaluable in helping us improve the experience for everyone.Thank you for your patience and understanding as we work through these challenges.

[h3]Let's stay in touch!
Chernobyl Again Dev Team[/h3]

notes.title: Recap of Steam Next Fest! 🚀
notes.content:
We're thrilled to share our experience from the recent Steam Next Fest, where we had an incredible time connecting with our community! 🎮

During the festival, we organized not just one, but [b]two live streams[/b] to dive deeper into the world of Chernobyl Again. It was fantastic to interact with you all and share insights about our game's development process. Your questions, feedback, and support mean the world to us!

The most significant moment of the event was t[b]he release of our demo[/b], which received an overwhelmingly positive response from players. We're deeply grateful for the enthusiasm and encouragement we've received from the gaming community. Your passion for Chernobyl Again motivates us to continue refining and improving the game!

We want to ensure that as many players as possible have the opportunity to experience our demo. Therefore, [b]we've decided to keep the demo available in the store until the end of February[/b] for those who haven't had a chance to play yet. We value your feedback and believe that it will contribute to further enhancing our game!

We'd like to express our warm thanks to everyone who participated in our streams, played the demo, and shared their thoughts and experiences with us. Your engagement and support inspire us, and it strengthens our belief that we are heading in the right direction.

Stay tuned for more updates on Chernobyl Again as we continue to work on bringing you an immersive and unforgettable gaming experience. Thank you once again for being part of this incredible journey with us!

[h3]Warm regards,
Chernobyl Again Dev Team[/h3]
